entries.en: Her manicure was ruined by an afternoon of digging in the garden.
entries.zh: 在花园里挖了一下午土，她做的指甲被弄坏了。

entries.en: She sent a pic of the finished mural to her brother.
entries.zh: 她把一张已完工壁画的照片发给了自己的兄弟。

entries.en: An incurable optimist, he expected sunshine despite the darkening clouds.
entries.zh: 他是个改不了的乐天派，尽管云层越来越暗，仍认为会有阳光。

entries.en: She grated cheddar over the steaming bowl of tomato soup.
entries.zh: 她把切达奶酪刨成碎屑，加在那碗热气腾腾的番茄汤上。

entries.en: A magnolia dropped pale petals onto the garden bench.
entries.zh: 一棵木兰的浅色花瓣落在了花园的长椅上。

entries.en: The office joker surprised us with a thoughtful farewell speech.
entries.zh: 办公室里那位爱开玩笑的人发表了一番用心的告别讲话，让我们很意外。

entries.en: He whinged about the rain until someone offered him a spare umbrella.
entries.zh: 他不停地抱怨下雨，直到有人表示愿意给他提供一把备用伞。

entries.en: The surrealist placed a tiny ocean inside a painted teacup.
entries.zh: 那位超现实主义艺术家在画中的茶杯里放进了一片微小的海洋。

entries.en: The novel's transvestite befriends a costume designer at the theatre.
entries.zh: 小说中的那位异装者在剧院与一位服装设计师成了朋友。

entries.en: My mother-in-law lent us a set of old gardening tools.
entries.zh: 我配偶的母亲借给我们一套旧园艺工具。

entries.en: Her self-imposed deadline left little time for extra illustrations.
entries.zh: 她给自己定下的截止日期，让她几乎没有时间再加画插图。

entries.meaningZh: 创作并演唱歌曲的歌手
entries.en: The singer-songwriter performed a ballad about her grandmother's village.
entries.zh: 那位创作歌手演唱了一首歌谣，唱的是她祖母或外祖母的村庄。

entries.en: The sought-after designer still made time for student workshops.
entries.zh: 那位备受追捧的设计师仍为学生工作坊抽出时间。

entries.en: The festival featured several up-and-coming designers from nearby colleges.
entries.zh: 这个节庆重点介绍了几位来自附近高校、崭露头角的设计师。

entries.en: Brian offered his window seat to a child carrying binoculars.
entries.zh: 布莱恩表示愿意把自己的靠窗座位让给一个带着望远镜的孩子。

entries.en: I recognized Chris by the red scarf his sister had knitted.
entries.zh: 我凭他的一位姐妹织的那条红围巾认出了克里斯。

entries.en: Philip found an old bus ticket inside the secondhand novel.
entries.zh: 菲利普在那本二手小说里发现了一张旧公交车票。

entries.en: My aunt sent me a sketch of the river in Newcastle.
entries.zh: 我一位姑姨辈的亲人寄给我一幅纽卡斯尔的河景素描。

entries.en: Laura recognized the house from her grandmother's description.
entries.zh: 劳拉根据自己祖母或外祖母的描述认出了那栋房子。

entries.en: My grandmother kept a journal of her walking holiday in Sussex.
entries.zh: 我的祖母或外祖母用日记记下了自己在苏塞克斯徒步度假的经历。

entries.en: Our friend in Sweden offered to send the missing music scores.
entries.zh: 我们在瑞典的朋友表示愿意寄来所缺的乐谱。

entries.en: Someday I hope to see the village where my grandfather grew up.
entries.zh: 我希望将来有一天能去看看自己的祖父或外祖父长大的村庄。

entries.en: We borrowed a cottage in Devon for a quiet autumn break.
entries.zh: 为了在秋日里安静地度个假，我们借用了德文郡的一间小屋。

entries.en: Each contributor received a copy of the finished magazine.
entries.zh: 每位投稿者都收到了一份制作完成的杂志。

entries.en: Our cousins in Lancaster sent us a box of local postcards.
entries.zh: 我们在兰开斯特的堂表亲给我们寄来了一盒当地明信片。

entries.en: Trevor offered me the window seat and put his bag under the table.
entries.zh: 特雷弗提出把靠窗的座位让给我，并把自己的包放在桌子底下。

entries.en: The photograph shows my grandparents on a beach in Suffolk.
entries.zh: 照片里，我的（外）祖父母在萨福克郡的一处海滩上。

entries.en: Steven found a quiet bench to repair his broken kite.
entries.zh: 史蒂文找了一张周围安静的长凳，好修理自己坏掉的风筝。

entries.en: Shelley took the smaller suitcase so her sister could use the larger one.
entries.zh: 谢莉拿了较小的行李箱，好让自己的一位姐妹用较大的那个。

entries.en: The farmer tedded the hay before the clouds gathered.
entries.zh: 农夫在云层聚拢之前翻晒了干草。

entries.en: We mailed a postcard from Windsor to my aunt.
entries.zh: 我们从温莎寄了一张明信片给我一位姑姨辈的亲人。

entries.en: Her cousins in Sutton invited us to stay for the weekend.
entries.zh: 她在萨顿的堂表亲邀请我们过去住一个周末。

entries.en: Pierre lifted the lid to check whether the bread had risen.
entries.zh: 皮埃尔揭开盖子，查看做面包的面团是否已经发起来了。

entries.en: Gerry spotted a heron beside the lock gate.
entries.zh: 格里在船闸门旁看见了一只鹭鸟。

entries.meaningZh: 乔（人名，常为Joanna或Josephine等名字的简称）
entries.en: Jo found a quiet table near the back of the cafe.
entries.zh: 乔在咖啡馆靠后的地方找到了一张周围安静的桌子。

entries.en: Wesley moved his desk away from the noisy corridor.
entries.zh: 韦斯利把自己的书桌移到了离那条嘈杂走廊更远的地方。

entries.en: The parcel addressed to Guil arrived without a return label.
entries.zh: 寄给吉尔的那个包裹送到了，但没有附上退寄标签。

entries.en: The film became internationally known after several festival screenings.
entries.zh: 这部电影在几次影展放映后，开始在国际上为人所知。

entries.en: Her cousin posted the missing photographs from Swansea.
entries.zh: 她的一位堂表亲从斯旺西寄出了所缺的照片。

entries.en: Christina recognised her grandfather's handwriting on the envelope.
entries.zh: 克里斯蒂娜认出了信封上自己祖父或外祖父的笔迹。

entries.en: He patiently untangled the necklace beneath the lamp.
entries.zh: 他在灯下耐心地理开了缠在一起的项链。
